Please, is anyone can help me??? Any advice it would be greatefoul!!!!
I have the x: data. I simulate from the fitdistr, to take the initial values of my chain. I wrote the posterior conditional of beta, which it follows a Gamma() and i do gibbs. After that, for alpha, because we dont know what type of distribution follows, (it's not tractable in closure form), i do Metropolis-Hastings with a loop for().
Here, is my code:

# Priors parameters
alpha0<- 0.01
beta0<- 0.01

# Data
x<-c(16,6,7,11,4,9,4,5,17,3)
rbind(x)
n<-length(x)


# Initial values from fitdistr

a0<- 3.2395390
b0<- 0.3950659

# Gibbs sampling for model:
gibbs<-function(iter){

# Initial values from fitdistr

a0<- 3.2395390
b0<- 0.3950659


beta<-numeric(iter) # iter= Number of iteration
beta<-c()
beta[1]<-b0
alpha<-numeric(iter)
alpha<-c()
alpha[1]<-a0


# Matrix that will contain recorded draws:

draws<-matrix(NA,ncol=2,nrow=iter)
# MCMC Loop Follows:

for(i in 2:iter){
# Draw beta:
# Posterior of beta is Gamma with parameters: Ga(n*alpha+a0,b0+sum(x))
beta[i]<-rgamma(n,n*alpha[i-1]+a0,b0+sum(x))


alpha<-((beta[i])^(n*alpha[i-1])*(b0^a0))/(gamma(a0)*gamma(alpha[i-1])^n)*exp(-(b0*alpha[i-1]+beta[i]*sum(x)))*(alpha[i-1])^(a0-1)*(prod(x))^(alpha[i-1]-1)


accept<-0
# Candidate alpha, draw from Normal

alpha[i]<-rnorm(1,mean=0,sd=1)

accept.prob<- dgamma(alpha[i],beta[i],x)/dgamma(alpha[i-1],beta[i],x)



if (runif(1)<accept.prob)

alpha[i]
else
alpha[i-1]
accept<-accept+1

draws[i,1]<-beta[i]
draws[i,2]<-alpha[i]
}
# End MCMC Loop
}
